universe_note: Signal symbols: 8h candles, shadow book and day marks come from Bybit mainnet public USDT klines. Orders go to venue.rest_base as coin + venue.quote.
limits_note: Ids follow risk-policy.md (merged cd4767c). All shares are of sleeve NAV. Changing any value here, or the gate code (tickets.py, execute.py, the gates, halts and resume in mdisc.py, governance below), is a risk-policy change (Runner independence): PR with Ingrid's approval.

execution.resting_target_note: Off. A resting PostOnly limit sell is not an order type L9 allows, so switching this on needs an L9 amendment to risk-policy.md (Ingrid's approval), not just this flag and the Demo test. Until then a target is taken at a wake.

governance.note: Halts (risk-policy.md, Halt levels): a runner halt opens a HALT issue in this project assigned to Nadia; resume needs that issue closed, no open HALT issue, a written review by Ingrid on it after the last halt reason, and a later resume comment by Nadia on it. A discretionary exit under a halt needs a comment by Nadia or Ingrid on an open HALT issue.

venue.note: Bybit EU Demo (Thierry's account is Bybit EU; THE-376). Every signed and venue-public call goes to rest_base, never a hard-coded host; in phase paper the runner accepts only https://api-demo.bybit.eu or https://api-demo.bybit.com. EU Demo lists no USDT spot pairs, only USDC and EUR: quote is USDC since risk-policy.md L1, sleeve and NAV moved to USDC (PR #20, db0e5b3). EU Demo serves no wallet-balance: O2 reconciles the ledger with the account's executions (execute.py, fills_sync / reconcile).
